items.title: Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build
items.content:
The barriers to building software have collapsed. Today, anyone can build. Hackathons are a great place to start learning.

The post Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
The barriers to building software have collapsed. Today, anyone can build. Hackathons are a great place to start learning.
The post Hack the World: Why hackathons are still the best place to learn to build appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Ed Summers

summaries.zh: 文章指出，如今构建软件的门槛已大幅降低，人人皆可参与。而黑客松（hackathons）仍是学习构建的最佳途径。通过参与黑客松，人们可以快速掌握相关技能。GitHub博客发布此文。
summaries.en: Hackathons remain the best place to learn software development due to the lowered barriers to building. They provide an accessible environment for beginners to gain practical experience and skills. The GitHub Blog highlights their value in fostering learning and creativity.

items.title: Secret protection must scale with software
items.content:
Developers aren’t becoming more careless; they’re being outpaced. The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it.

The post Secret protection must scale with software appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
Developers aren’t becoming more careless; they’re being outpaced. The tools that let developers create more software should also take on more of the work of protecting it.
The post Secret protection must scale with software appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Erin Havens

summaries.zh:
文章标题：《秘密保护必须与软件规模相匹配》

文章内容摘要：开发者并非变得粗心，而是被发展速度甩在身后。让开发者能创建更多软件的工具，也应承担更多保护软件的工作。
summaries.en: The article argues that as developers create more software, the tools they use must also improve secret protection to keep pace. It states that developers are not becoming less careful but are overwhelmed due to the increasing complexity of software development. The key message is that secret protection must scale with software to ensure security remains effective. The article emphasizes the need for enhanced protective tools to support developers in safeguarding their work.

items.title: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
items.content:
We’re launching ReviewBench, a benchmark for code review agents built on representative GitHub pull requests, multi-source ground truth, calibrated evaluation, and production-aligned metrics.

The post ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.contentSnippet:
We’re launching ReviewBench, a benchmark for code review agents built on representative GitHub pull requests, multi-source ground truth, calibrated evaluation, and production-aligned metrics.
The post ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review appeared first on The GitHub Blog.
items.creator: Michelle Zhou

summaries.zh: ReviewBench 是一个面向 AI 代码审查的开放基准，基于 GitHub 拉取请求、多源标注数据、校准评估和与生产环境对齐的指标构建。该基准旨在为代码审查代理提供标准化测试平台。GitHub 官方博客发布此消息。
summaries.en: ReviewBench is an open benchmark for AI code review, developed using representative GitHub pull requests, multi-source ground truth, calibrated evaluation, and production-aligned metrics. It provides a standardized way to assess the performance of code review agents. The initiative aims to improve the quality and reliability of AI-driven code review tools. The benchmark is publicly available for researchers and developers to use.
